title: Resource Allocation and Stage Reviews in Public Projects
prompt: Some people believe that large public projects should be reviewed at every stage of development, with funding released only when each stage meets agreed standards. Others argue that such frequent checks waste money and slow progress, and that resources are better concentrated on completing the work. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, explain which approach you consider more effective for allocating limited public resources, and support your position with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明两种立场：支持分阶段检查与拨款的理由（如减少浪费、及时纠错、提高问责），以及反对者的理由（如行政成本、延误工期、抑制创新）。随后明确给出你自己的观点，并说明在公共资源有限的条件下哪种做法更有效。请使用具体但虚构的例子支撑论证，避免只罗列观点。注意任务要求为讨论双方观点并给出个人意见，字数不少于250词。
